claims.narration: MH370 berlepas dari Kuala Lumpur ke Beijing pada 8 Mac 2014.

claims.claim: Military radar indicated the aircraft turned back across Peninsular Malaysia.
claims.narration: Radar tentera menunjukkan pesawat itu berpatah balik merentasi Semenanjung.

claims.claim: Satellite data redirected the search toward the southern Indian Ocean.
claims.narration: Data satelit kemudian mengalihkan pencarian ke selatan Lautan Hindi.

claims.claim: Debris confirmed to be from MH370 was recovered far from the main search area.
claims.narration: Serpihan yang disahkan milik MH370 ditemui jauh dari kawasan carian utama.

claims.claim: The main wreckage and exact cause have not been established.
claims.narration: Bangkai utama dan punca tepat kehilangan masih belum dikenal pasti.

story.title: Apa Punca Highland Towers Runtuh?
story.summary: Siasatan teknikal menelusuri bagaimana hujan, saliran dan tanah runtuh membawa kepada keruntuhan Blok 1.

sources.title: Geotechnical engineering investigations of the Highland Tower Condominium collapse
Tragedi Highland Towers: Noktah musibah tiga dekad

claims.claim: Block 1 collapsed on 11 December 1993 and 48 people died.
claims.narration: Pada 11 Disember 1993, Blok 1 Highland Towers runtuh dan mengorbankan 48 nyawa.

claims.claim: The technical investigation identified retrogressive landslides behind Block 1 as the most probable cause.
claims.narration: Siasatan teknikal mengenal pasti siri tanah runtuh di belakang Blok 1 sebagai punca paling berkemungkinan.

claims.claim: The landslides destabilised a rail-pile foundation not designed for lateral loading.
claims.narration: Pergerakan tanah itu menggugat asas cerucuk yang tidak direka untuk menahan beban sisi.

claims.claim: Inadequate drainage and poor drain maintenance increased runoff and infiltration.
claims.narration: Saliran yang tidak mencukupi serta penyelenggaraan lemah meningkatkan aliran dan resapan air ke cerun.

claims.claim: Three victims were rescued alive on the first day.
claims.narration: Di tengah tragedi itu, tiga mangsa berjaya diselamatkan hidup-hidup pada hari pertama.

claims.claim: The disaster became a lasting national lesson in slope safety and disaster preparedness.
claims.narration: Highland Towers bukan misteri ghaib—ia amaran tentang bagaimana beberapa kegagalan boleh bergabung menjadi bencana.

story.title: Legenda Villa Nabila
story.summary: Sebuah banglo terbiar di Johor Bahru menjadi legenda bandar selepas khabar kehilangan beramai-ramai tersebar di media sosial.

sources.title: Polis Johor nafi kehilangan sekumpulan remaja di Villa Nabila
Detik cemas dikacau penunggu Villa Nabila

claims.claim: Villa Nabila is an abandoned bungalow near Danga Bay in Johor Bahru.
claims.narration: Di sebuah bukit berhampiran Danga Bay berdiri banglo terbiar yang dikenali sebagai Villa Nabila.

claims.claim: Stories about deaths and paranormal activity at the villa circulated as urban legends.
claims.narration: Pelbagai cerita tentang kematian dan gangguan paranormal tersebar dari mulut ke mulut, tetapi asal-usulnya tidak dapat disahkan.

claims.claim: A viral claim said a large group of teenagers had disappeared at the villa in 2013.
claims.narration: Pada 2013, media sosial mendakwa sekumpulan besar remaja hilang selepas memasuki vila itu.

claims.claim: Johor police said they had received only one missing-person report, not reports for the viral number.
claims.narration: Polis Johor menafikan kehilangan beramai-ramai dan berkata hanya satu laporan orang hilang diterima.

claims.claim: The missing 16-year-old was later found at a friend's home.
claims.narration: Remaja berusia 16 tahun itu kemudian ditemui di rumah rakannya, bukan hilang di dalam Villa Nabila.

claims.claim: The paranormal stories remain unverified folklore.
claims.narration: Apa yang kekal misteri ialah asal sebenar legenda itu—bukan bukti bahawa dakwaan paranormal tersebut benar.
